event: Fiscal Q3 2026 print. Adjusted EPS $5.68 beat. Revenue $21.56B, +37.7% year over year. Shares opened down about 11% (prior close $287.89, print near $256).
outside: RTT News and 24/7 Wall St., 24 Sep 2026. Operating cash flow swung to about a $917m outflow. Free-cash-flow consumption was about $976m on inventory for Hyve AI servers. Gross margin fell 61 bps.

pre_event.note: Weeks breakout looked like strength. The pack course was already sell-the-news, not a new buy.

model_miss: The weeks score (bo 1.69 into the print) and a revenue beat both looked like support. Neither priced a working-capital cash outflow. The financial-projection terminal is empty, so there was no model price to gap against. The leftover reopened to 30% only because the price fell.
lesson: Do not buy a name into a print when the pack course is SELL_THE_NEWS, even if weeks bo is high. After the gap, do not buy the reopened leftover the same day. An empty model terminal is not confirmation. A distributor with thin operating margin can beat EPS and still gap down on cash flow.
applies_to: weeks breakout used as a buy
wisdom forward_value rows with empty fp_terminal_px

companion_reject.why: Pack NEW support 0.65 on 24 Sep. Model terminal 5.85 against a 98.6 close, model upside -94%. A terminal that far under the price is a reject, not a starter.
